records.qtitle: Impact of section 43B(h) (Finance Act 2023) on MSMEs
records.name: Rajeev Kumar
records.qn_text:
(a) section 43B(h) (Finance Act 2023, effective FY 2024-25) disallows a tax deduction to buyers until they actually pay a micro/small supplier, to enforce the 45-day timeline, but reporting indicates a significant unintended consequence: large and medium buyers began cancelling orders with registered MSMEs; and
(b) shifting to unregistered vendors or pressuring small suppliers to surrender their Udyam registration — because the rule bites only if the supplier is Udyam-registered, the sector has been hurt more than benefited, the steps Government is taking to rectify the situation, if any?

records.subject: New Customs Integrated System
records.extent:
The existing Customs automated ecosystem, comprising of ICES (Indian Customs 
EDI System), ICEGATE (Indian Customs Electronic Data Interchange Gateway) 
and associated applications, is proposed to be comprehensively modernised through 
the Customs Integrated System (CIS). The procurement process for selection of the 
Implementation Agency has been initiated.
